title: General Passive Network
text: Model two-port passive network described by rfdata object, {Interpolation method} sets Method to interpolate network parameters; {Data source}, {Data file} sets the name of file that contains passive device data, {RFDATA object} sets the rF data object that contains passive device data, {Source of frequency data} sets the frequency data source Extracted from data, {Frequency data}, {Reference impedance (ohms)}, {Plot type} sets the type of data plot, {Y parameter1} sets the type of parameters, {Y parameter2} sets the type of parameters, {Y format1} plots format Magnitude, {Y format2} plots format Magnitude, {X parameter} sets the frequency plot, {X format} sets the frequency plot format, {Y scale} sets the y-axis scale, {X scale} sets the x-axis scale and {Plot}. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Data source
params.values: Data source that describes the passive device behaviour Data file (default) | RFDATA object

params.name: Data file
params.values: Name of file that contains passive device data passive.s2p (default) | string | character vector

params.name: RFDATA object
params.values: RF data object that contains passive device data read(rfdata.data, ’passive.s2p’) (default) | rfdata.data object

params.name: Interpolation method
params.values: Method to interpolate network parameters Linear (default) | Spline | Cubic

params.name: Source of frequency data
params.values: Frequency data source Extracted from data source (default) | User-specified

params.name: Plot type
params.values: Type of data plot X-Y plane (default) | Composite data | Polar plane | Z Smith chart | Y Smith chart | ZY Smith chart

params.name: Y parameter1
params.values: Type of parameters to plot S11 (default) | S12 | S21 | S22 | GroupDelay | OIP3 | IIP3 | NF |...

params.name: Y parameter2
params.values: Type of parameters to plot S11 (default) | S12 | S21 | S22 | GroupDelay | OIP3 | IIP3 | NF |...

params.name: Y format1
params.values: Plot format Magnitude (decibels) (default) | Mag | Magnitude (linear) | Angle | Real | Imaginary |...

params.name: Y format2
params.values: Plot format Magnitude (decibels) (default) | Mag | Magnitude (linear) | Angle | Real | Imaginary |...

params.name: X format
params.values: Frequency plot format Hz (default) | Auto | kHz | MHz | GHz | THz
